programs.desc: Gorgonzola, the grandaddy of all European blue cheeses made from cows' milk and its cousin cave ripened Taleggio, which until recently was one of Italy's great soft cheese secrets. Will travels to Northern Italy to see how and where these fascinating cheeses are created. He visits Lombardy, and the maze of underground cellars in the town of Novara where more than 70% of Gorgonzola is matured.
